name: EIC Pathfinder Open  TRL 1-4 breakthrough deep-tech research

documents.title: Part B  Pathfinder Open Technical Proposal (RIA template)

sub.label: 1.1 Long-term vision + radically new technology
prompts: Describe the radically new technology vision and the science-towards-technology breakthrough.

sub.label: 1.2 Concrete + novel science-towards-technology breakthrough
prompts: What is the concrete novel and ambitious science-towards-technology breakthrough you propose?

sub.label: 1.3 High-risk / high-gain research approach + methodology
prompts: Describe the high-risk/high-gain approach + methodology + concrete and plausible objectives.

sub.label: 1.4 Interdisciplinarity
prompts: How does the proposal combine different disciplines? Why is this necessary for the breakthrough?

sub.label: 2.1 Potential for new markets + transformation
prompts: Future application areas + potential to create new markets and transform existing ones.

sub.label: 2.2 Communication + dissemination + IPR strategy
prompts: Open-science obligations; dissemination plan; IPR exploitation strategy.

sub.label: 3.1 Work plan + work packages + deliverables + milestones
prompts: Define WPs, deliverables, milestones, critical risks, contingency.

sub.label: 3.2 Capacity of consortium
prompts: Roles, complementarities, distribution of tasks, gender balance in consortium.

sub.label: 3.3 Resources
prompts: Personnel, subcontracting, equipment depreciation, indirect costs (25% flat rate).

hand_offs.chat_cta: Ask Brubru if my consortium configuration meets the 3-from-3 rule
